tagline.en: A real-time, audio-visual world model distilled for fast interactive generation.
tagline.zh: 一个实时的视听世界模型，经蒸馏以实现快速交互式生成。

en: OmniForcing is an audio-visual world model built for real-time generation. Rather than producing images alone, it works across both video and audio, aiming to simulate a world you can interact with as it unfolds.

Speed is a core goal: OmniForcing uses distillation to compress a heavier model into a faster one, so it can generate at interactive rates. This makes it suited to live, responsive settings where latency matters as much as quality.
In WorldFoundry, OmniForcing is registered through its official source, with the model checkpoints and runtime assets prepared separately before you generate.
zh: OmniForcing 是一个面向实时生成的视听世界模型。它不只产出画面，而是同时处理视频与音频，目标是模拟一个可以随其展开而交互的世界。
速度是它的核心目标：OmniForcing 通过蒸馏把一个较重的模型压缩成更快的版本，从而能以交互速率生成。这让它适合延迟与画质同样重要的实时、响应式场景。
在 WorldFoundry 中，OmniForcing 通过其官方源接入，模型 checkpoint 与运行时资源需在生成前单独准备。

whenToUse.en: Consider OmniForcing when you need real-time, interactive generation that spans both audio and video, and low latency matters as much as fidelity.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要同时覆盖音频与视频的实时、交互式生成，且低延迟与画质同等重要时，可以考虑 OmniForcing。

notFor.en: Not aimed at slow, maximum-fidelity offline rendering — its design trades toward speed. Checkpoints and runtime assets are prepared separately before use.
notFor.zh: 它并非面向缓慢、极致保真的离线渲染——其设计偏向速度。checkpoint 与运行时资源需在使用前单独准备。

en: Distilled for speed at interactive rates
Registered in WorldFoundry via its official source
zh: 视听一体的世界模型，而非仅有视频
面向实时、交互式生成构建
经蒸馏以在交互速率下运行
